abilities.name: Inferno Surge
abilities.description: Unleash a concentrated blast of fire at one target.

abilities.name: Light
abilities.description: Make a small object glow with magical light.

abilities.name: Cunning Action
abilities.description: Gain one extra action this phase; once per phase.

abilities.name: Backstab
abilities.description: Exploit a distracted enemy for a precise, punishing strike.

abilities.name: Hunter's Mark
abilities.description: Mark a visible target; your next hit against it deals extra damage.

abilities.name: Pinning Shot
abilities.description: A careful shot that can pin a target's clothing or slow its movement.

abilities.name: Cone of Cold
abilities.description: Blast a short cone of freezing air, threatening several nearby foes.

abilities.name: Blink Step
abilities.description: Teleport a short distance to escape an enemy or gain a better firing angle.

abilities.name: Chain Lightning
abilities.description: Lightning leaps from the first target to another nearby enemy.

abilities.name: Thunderclap
abilities.description: Release a close-range burst of thunder that can stagger nearby foes.

abilities.name: Life Drain
abilities.description: Pull vitality from an enemy to mend your own wounds.

abilities.name: Curse of Weakness
abilities.description: Curse a target, weakening its next attack.

abilities.name: Flurry of Blows
abilities.description: Spend your momentum on a flurry of fast unarmed strikes.

abilities.name: Chi Dash
abilities.description: Burst forward with ki, repositioning without giving up your attack.

abilities.name: Companion Strike
abilities.description: Command your loyal beast to lunge at a nearby enemy.

abilities.name: Snare Trap
abilities.description: Set or trigger a snare that can hinder an enemy crossing its space.

abilities.name: Quick Reload
abilities.description: Reload and fire in one smooth motion; once per phase.

abilities.name: Trick Shot
abilities.description: Bank a shot around cover or aim for a weapon held by the target.

abilities.name: Flame Lunge
abilities.description: Dash into melee with a flaming blade strike.

abilities.name: Draconic Roar
abilities.description: Unleash a fierce roar that can shake the resolve of nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Twin-Horn Assault
abilities.description: Strike an adjacent enemy twice, rolling separately for each attack and each successful strike's damage.

abilities.name: Crushing Mark
abilities.description: Mark an enemy within 5 squares; your next hit against it deals an additional 1d4 damage.

abilities.name: Relentless Pursuit
abilities.description: Once per phase, gain 2 additional movement squares this turn.

abilities.name: Falling Star
abilities.description: Call down a burst of astral energy on a point near an enemy, attacking every enemy within 2 squares of the chosen target.

abilities.name: Phase Step
abilities.description: Teleport up to 5 squares to an unoccupied square and empower your next hit to deal 50% more damage.

abilities.name: Unblinking Volley
abilities.description: Unleash three eye-lance strikes against one enemy, rolling each attack and successful hit's damage independently.

abilities.name: Paralyzing Gaze
abilities.description: Fix an enemy within 5 squares with your unblinking gaze. If your roll meets its Defense, it becomes snared through the next DM phase.

abilities.name: Briarstorm Flurry
abilities.description: Unleash two rapid rapier strikes against an adjacent enemy, with independent attack and damage rolls.

abilities.name: Envenomed Opening
abilities.description: Launch a venomous spine at an enemy within 5 squares. On a hit, deal damage and poison the target, imposing −2 to hit through the next DM phase.

abilities.name: Corona Burst
abilities.description: Detonate a sphere of sunlight around a chosen enemy, attacking every enemy within 2 squares of the target.

abilities.name: Mark of the Sun
abilities.description: Mark an enemy with radiant energy. Your next hit against it deals an additional 1d6 damage.

abilities.name: Soul Rend
abilities.description: Rip at an enemy's life force for necrotic damage. On a hit, the target takes 3 additional damage from incoming hits through the next DM phase.

abilities.name: Grave Chains
abilities.description: Call spectral chains around an enemy within 5 squares. On a successful roll against its Defense, the target is snared through the next DM phase.

abilities.name: Rootquake
abilities.description: Stomp the ground and send roots surging outward, attacking every enemy within 2 squares.

abilities.name: Piercing Bark
abilities.description: Launch a sharpened sliver of enchanted bark at an enemy within 6 squares, treating its Defense as 3 lower for this attack.

abilities.name: Ricochet Trick Shot
abilities.description: Fire a clever ricochet shot that can leap from the first target to up to two additional enemies within 3 squares of the previous target.

abilities.name: Evasive Dash
abilities.description: Dash an additional 3 squares and gain +2 Defense for the remainder of the current turn.

abilities.name: Piercing Frost
abilities.description: Hurl a concentrated spear of ice at an enemy within 7 squares for heavy cold damage.

abilities.name: Frozen Mark
abilities.description: Mark an enemy with freezing runes. Your next hit against it deals an additional 1d6 damage.

abilities.name: Prismatic Blast
abilities.description: Detonate a prismatic burst around a chosen enemy, attacking all enemies within 1 square of the target.

abilities.name: Overcharged Sigil
abilities.description: Empower your next hit to deal 50% more damage.

abilities.name: Soul Piercer
abilities.description: Fire a lance of shadow energy that tears into an enemy's life force.

abilities.name: Grasp of the Void
abilities.description: Attempt to bind an enemy within 5 squares in shadowy tendrils, snaring it through the next DM phase on success.

abilities.name: Localized Blizzard
abilities.description: Summon a freezing storm around a chosen enemy, attacking all enemies within 2 squares of the target.

abilities.name: Biting Chill
abilities.description: Strike an enemy with bitter cold, dealing damage and applying the slowed status on a hit.

abilities.name: Cinderburst
abilities.description: Explode a point in searing flame, attacking all enemies within 1 square of the chosen target.

abilities.name: Ignition
abilities.description: Brand an enemy with volatile fire magic. Your next hit against it deals an additional 1d6 damage.

abilities.name: Soulstorm
abilities.description: Unleash a storm of restless souls around a chosen enemy, attacking all enemies within 1 square of the target.

abilities.name: Withering Curse
abilities.description: Curse an enemy within 6 squares, leaving it shaken through the next DM phase if your roll meets its Defense.

abilities.name: Chaos Bolts
abilities.description: Hurl three unstable bolts at one enemy, each with its own attack roll and damage roll on a hit.

abilities.name: Impish Escape
abilities.description: Gain 3 additional movement squares and +2 Defense for the current turn.

abilities.name: Predator's Lunge
abilities.description: Lunge at an enemy within 5 squares and strike it in melee for heavy damage.

abilities.name: Hunter's Mark
abilities.description: Mark your prey. Your next hit against the marked enemy deals an additional 1d6 damage.

abilities.name: Discordant Chord
abilities.description: Strike a discordant chord that releases a thunderous wave of sound against an enemy within 6 squares.

abilities.name: Rhythm of Ruin
abilities.description: Build a dangerous rhythm, gaining +2 on your next attack or check roll.

abilities.name: Solar Judgment
abilities.description: Call down a focused ray of sunlight that strikes an enemy within 6 squares.

abilities.name: Executioner's Mark
abilities.description: Mark a foe for execution. Your next hit against it deals an additional 1d8 damage.

abilities.name: Earthshaker
abilities.description: Slam the ground, attacking all enemies within 2 squares.

abilities.name: Rending Blow
abilities.description: Deliver a brutal strike to an adjacent enemy, reducing its Defense by 2 through the next DM phase on a hit.

abilities.name: Hexburst
abilities.description: Blast an enemy with violet curse energy. On a hit, it becomes shaken through the next DM phase.

abilities.name: Shadow Step
abilities.description: Teleport to an unoccupied square up to 5 squares away.

abilities.name: Chain Lightning
abilities.description: Unleash lightning that strikes the first enemy and can jump to up to two additional enemies within 3 squares of the previous target.

abilities.name: Thunderclap
abilities.description: Release a thunderous shockwave, attacking every enemy within 1 square.

abilities.name: Pack Hunter's Volley
abilities.description: Fire two quick arrows at a single enemy, resolving each attack and damage roll independently.

abilities.name: Snowbind
abilities.description: Encase an enemy in freezing snow, applying the slowed status through the next DM phase if your roll meets its Defense.

abilities.name: Moonshadow Ambush
abilities.description: Strike from the shadows with a precision shot against an enemy within 6 squares.

abilities.name: Hunter's Focus
abilities.description: Focus your aim, gaining +2 on your next attack or check roll.
